type RouteResult = { status: number; body: { error: string } };

function guardRoute<T>(run: () => T): T | RouteResult {
  try {
    return run();
  } catch (error) {

      ? (error as { status: number }).status

    return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };

}

interface ErrorResult {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly body: { readonly error: string };
}

function routeGuard<T>(run: () => T): T | ErrorResult {
  try {
    return run();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      const status = (error as Error & { status?: unknown }).status;
      if (typeof status === "number" && status >= 400 && status < 500) {
        return { status, body: { error: error.message } };
      }
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

type RouteResult = { status: number; body: { error: string } };

function guardRoute<T>(run: () => T): T | RouteResult {
  try {
    return run();
  } catch (error) {

      ? (error as { status: number }).status

    return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };

}

interface ErrorResult {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly body: { readonly error: string };
}

function routeGuard<T>(run: () => T): T | ErrorResult {
  try {
    return run();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      const status = (error as Error & { status?: unknown }).status;
      if (typeof status === "number" && status >= 400 && status < 500) {
        return { status, body: { error: error.message } };
      }
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```
